messages.content: What were the most impactful cases handled by law firm ABC in the year 2020?

function.name: case_info_get
function.description: Retrieve case details including the judgement from a case id. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

case_id.description: The unique id for the case.

case_year.description: The year when the case was conducted.

message.content:
I’m happy to help, but I’ll need a bit more detail to pull up the relevant information. Could you let me know:

1. The specific case IDs (or at least the case names) that ABC handled in 2020, or  
2. Any particular criteria you’re using to define “most impactful” (e.g., size of settlement, precedent-setting rulings, media coverage, etc.).

Once I have that, I can retrieve the case details and provide you with the information you’re looking for.
